reason: Guests come to me through Booking.com and they trust that name, not my website. A studio I have never heard of selling me a booking page for 800 dollars, plus a boat transfer story, sounds nice but I do not believe my own site will bring anyone who is not already mine.
objection: If I move guests off Booking.com, my visibility drops and I lose the new guests I cannot get any other way. I have seen what happens when a listing goes quiet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my own numbers: how many of my bookings are repeat or referral guests who would book direct anyway, and a written promise that Booking.com stays on as the main channel while the direct page only takes the repeat guests.
